deliverables: Custodial wallet onboarding for Sellout users
Public launch campaign and trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and governance reporting
request.recipient: Intersect as budget administrator through the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework, with delivery by Anvil Development Agency and Sellout.io as operating partner.
request.what: Withdraw 4,969,231 ada to fund Phase 2 of a Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency.

claims.claim: Phase 1 of the ticketing platform is already live on Cardano mainnet with on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification.
Sellout has invested over $130,000 of its own capital into Phase 1.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, including a 3% Intersect administration fee, over 8 months.
Phase 2 will deliver a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and a launch campaign.
The team commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism using 25% of fees until full reimbursement and 5% thereafter.
The proposal targets 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6 million in on-chain ticket revenue, and 20,000+ new wallets within 12 months from launch.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment projected to move more than $6 million through Cardano in Year 1.
All on-chain metrics are said to be independently verifiable through Cardano explorer data, policy-ID tracking, a public M5 dashboard, and quarterly Cardano Forum reports.
Anvil and Sellout state they have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.
The requested amount is stated not to breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.

summary: The document requests a large milestone-gated treasury withdrawal for an enterprise ticketing platform expansion, with detailed deliverables, budget lines, repayment claims, adoption targets, and oversight structure, but several central claims about current deployment, contracted volume, and repayment feasibility are asserted rather than evidenced in the document.
